import requests, re, json
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# ============ consolidated provenance re-run ============
# 1) sequences + single difference
def fa(a):
    t=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=60).text.split("\n")
    return "".join(t[1:])
A,B=fa("P83881"),fa("Q969Q0")
diff=[(i+1,x,y) for i,(x,y) in enumerate(zip(A,B)) if x!=y]
assert len(A)==len(B)==106
print("identity %d/106 (%.2f%%); differences: %s"%(106-len(diff),100*(106-len(diff))/106,diff))

# 2) structure: SASA + contacts for eL42 in 6EK0
cif=requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/6EK0.cif",timeout=900).text
L=cif.split("\n"); i=0
while not L[i].startswith("_atom_site."): i+=1
cols=[];j=i
while L[j].startswith("_atom_site."): cols.append(L[j].strip().split(".")[-1]); j+=1
rec=[];k=j
while k<len(L) and not L[k].startswith("#"):
    if L[k].strip(): rec.append(L[k].split())
    k+=1
at=pd.DataFrame(rec,columns=cols); at=at[at.group_PDB=="ATOM"].copy()
for c,n in [("Cartn_x","x"),("Cartn_y","y"),("Cartn_z","z")]: at[n]=at[c].astype(float)
at["resi"]=pd.to_numeric(at.label_seq_id,errors="coerce")
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
NUC={'A','U','G','C'}
el=at[at.auth_asym_id=="Lo"].copy()
RAD={'C':1.70,'N':1.55,'O':1.52,'S':1.80,'P':1.80,'MG':1.73,'ZN':1.39}
rad=lambda d: d.type_symbol.str.upper().map(RAD).fillna(1.70).values
idx=np.arange(400)+0.5; phi=np.arccos(1-2*idx/400); th=np.pi*(1+5**0.5)*idx
SP=np.c_[np.cos(th)*np.sin(phi),np.sin(th)*np.sin(phi),np.cos(phi)]; PR=1.4
def sasa(tx,tr,ex,er):
    o=np.zeros(len(tx))
    for a in range(len(tx)):
        ra=tr[a]+PR; pts=tx[a]+SP*ra
        d=np.linalg.norm(ex-tx[a],axis=1); nb=np.where((d<ra+er.max()+PR)&(d>1e-6))[0]
        acc=np.ones(len(pts),bool)
        for b in nb: acc &= np.linalg.norm(pts-ex[b],axis=1)>=(er[b]+PR)
        o[a]=4*np.pi*ra**2*acc.mean()
    return o
elx=el[["x","y","z"]].values; elr=rad(el)
cen=elx.mean(0); R=np.linalg.norm(elx-cen,axis=1).max()
allx=at[["x","y","z"]].values; allr=rad(at); keep=np.linalg.norm(allx-cen,axis=1)<R+16
el["iso"]=sasa(elx,elr,elx,elr); el["cpx"]=sasa(elx,elr,allx[keep],allr[keep])
MAX={'A':129,'R':274,'N':195,'D':193,'C':167,'E':223,'Q':225,'G':104,'H':224,'I':197,'L':201,
'K':236,'M':224,'F':240,'P':159,'S':155,'T':172,'W':285,'Y':263,'V':174}
res=el.groupby("resi").agg(aa3=("label_comp_id","first"),iso=("iso","sum"),cpx=("cpx","sum"))
res["aa"]=res.aa3.map(AA3); res["rsa_iso"]=res.iso/res.aa.map(MAX); res["rsa_cpx"]=res.cpx/res.aa.map(MAX)
oth=at[at.auth_asym_id!="Lo"]; ox=oth[["x","y","z"]].values; k2=np.linalg.norm(ox-cen,axis=1)<R+10
o2=oth[k2].copy(); o2x=ox[k2]
crna=np.zeros(len(res)); cpro=np.zeros(len(res)); ridx={r:n for n,r in enumerate(res.index)}
for a in range(len(elx)):
    d=np.linalg.norm(o2x-elx[a],axis=1); h=np.where(d<=4.0)[0]
    for q in h:
        r=el.iloc[a].resi
        if o2.iloc[q].label_comp_id in NUC: crna[ridx[r]]+=1
        else: cpro[ridx[r]]+=1
res["rRNA_or_tRNA_contacts"]=crna; res["protein_contacts"]=cpro
res.round(3).to_csv("eL42_6EK0_per_residue_sasa_contacts.csv")
r38=res.loc[38]
print("\nres38: %s  RSA isolated %.3f  RSA in 80S %.3f  nucleic contacts %d  protein contacts %d"%(
    r38.aa3,r38.rsa_iso,r38.rsa_cpx,r38.rRNA_or_tRNA_contacts,r38.protein_contacts))
print("eL42 chain mean RSA in 80S %.3f ; %d/%d residues contact nucleic acid"%(
    res.rsa_cpx.mean(),(res.rRNA_or_tRNA_contacts>0).sum(),len(res)))

# 3) MS observations of diagnostic peptides
H={"Accept":"application/json"}
ms={}
for acc,sym in [("P83881","RPL36A"),("Q969Q0","RPL36AL")]:
    f=requests.get(f"https://www.ebi.ac.uk/proteins/api/proteomics/{acc}",headers=H,timeout=120).json()
    feats=(f[0] if isinstance(f,list) else f)["features"]
    for ft in feats:
        n=[]
        for e in ft.get("evidences",[]):
            p=(e.get("source") or {}).get("properties") or {}
            if "Times of observations" in p: n.append(int(p["Times of observations"]))
        if ft.get("peptide") in ("DSLYAQGK","DSLYAQGR","GKDSLYAQGK","GKDSLYAQGR","KGKDSLYAQGK","KGKDSLYAQGR"):
            ms[(sym,ft["peptide"])]=max(n) if n else 0
print("\nPeptideAtlas observation counts for paralog-diagnostic peptides:"); print(ms)

# 4) GTEx
def gid(s):
    g=requests.get("https://gtexportal.org/api/v2/reference/gene",params={"geneId":s,"itemsPerPage":20},timeout=120).json()
    return [d for d in g["data"] if d["geneSymbol"].upper()==s.upper()][0]["gencodeId"]
e=requests.get("https://gtexportal.org/api/v2/expression/medianGeneExpression",
   params={"gencodeId":[gid("RPL36A"),gid("RPL36AL")],"datasetId":"gtex_v8","itemsPerPage":200},timeout=180).json()
piv=pd.DataFrame(e["data"]).pivot_table(index="tissueSiteDetailId",columns="geneSymbol",values="median")
piv["log2"]=np.log2(piv.RPL36A/piv.RPL36AL)

# ============ figure ============
fig=plt.figure(figsize=(14,9))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(2,2,height_ratios=[1,1.1],hspace=0.35,wspace=0.25)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,:])
ax.bar(res.index,res.rsa_iso,color="#cbd5e0",label="isolated eL42 chain")
ax.bar(res.index,res.rsa_cpx,color="#2b6cb0",label="eL42 inside the 80S ribosome")
ax.plot([38],[res.loc[38,"rsa_cpx"]+0.06],marker="v",color="#c53030",ms=10)
ax.annotate("position 38: K in RPL36A, R in RPL36AL\n(only difference between the paralogs)\nRSA %.2f, contacts C74 of E-site tRNA"%r38.rsa_cpx,
            xy=(38,res.loc[38,"rsa_cpx"]+0.07),xytext=(48,0.78),color="#c53030",fontsize=9,
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",color="#c53030"))
ax.set_xlabel("eL42 residue"); ax.set_ylabel("relative solvent accessibility")
ax.set_title("Human eL42 in the 80S ribosome (PDB 6EK0, chain Lo): burial per residue")
ax.legend(frameon=False,loc="upper right")

ax2=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0])
peps=["DSLYAQGK","GKDSLYAQGK","KGKDSLYAQGK","DSLYAQGR","GKDSLYAQGR","KGKDSLYAQGR"]
vals=[ms.get(("RPL36A",p),0) or ms.get(("RPL36AL",p),0) for p in peps]
cols2=["#2b6cb0"]*3+["#d69e2e"]*3
ax2.barh(range(6),vals,color=cols2)
ax2.set_yticks(range(6)); ax2.set_yticklabels(peps,fontsize=9,family="monospace"); ax2.invert_yaxis()
ax2.set_xscale("log"); ax2.set_xlabel("times observed, PeptideAtlas (log scale)")
ax2.set_title("Both diagnostic peptides are already\nabundant in public human MS data")
for n,v in enumerate(vals): ax2.text(v*1.15,n,str(v),va="center",fontsize=8)

ax3=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,1])
o=piv.sort_values("log2")
ax3.barh(range(len(o)),o.log2,color=["#2b6cb0" if v>0 else "#d69e2e" for v in o.log2])
ax3.axvline(0,color="k",lw=1); ax3.set_yticks([]); ax3.invert_yaxis()
ax3.set_xlabel("log2(RPL36A / RPL36AL) median TPM")
ax3.set_title("GTEx v8, 54 tissues: both paralogs expressed everywhere\n(whole blood %.1f  to  sun-exposed skin %.1f)"%(o.log2.min(),o.log2.max()),fontsize=10)
ax3.text(o.log2.min()*0.95,2,"whole blood",fontsize=8,va="center")
ax3.text(o.log2.max()*0.35,len(o)-3,"skin",fontsize=8,va="center")
plt.show()

# evidence table artifact
tab=pd.DataFrame([
 dict(analysis="pairwise alignment P83881 vs Q969Q0",result="105/106 identical; single difference K38/R38",source="UniProt"),
 dict(analysis="proteome-wide peptide uniqueness (42,560 reviewed human entries + isoforms)",
      result="DSLYAQGK unique to RPL36A; DSLYAQGR unique to RPL36AL",source="UniProtKB Swiss-Prot"),
 dict(analysis="readthrough check",result="DSLYAQGK also in RPL36A-HNRNPH2 readthrough fragments H0Y3V9, H7BZ11",source="UniProtKB TrEMBL"),
 dict(analysis="structure, 6EK0 chain Lo residue 38",
      result=f"RSA {r38.rsa_cpx:.2f} in 80S (partially exposed); 1 contact <=4 A to C74 of E-site tRNA chain S6; 0 protein contacts",
      source="PDB 6EK0, Shrake-Rupley SASA computed here"),
 dict(analysis="ortholog scan of position 38",result="K in all 9 reviewed vertebrate RPL36A entries; R in both reviewed RPL36AL entries (human, Pongo)",source="UniProtKB"),
 dict(analysis="public MS evidence",result="DSLYAQGK observed 4,756x; DSLYAQGR observed 3,139x (PeptideAtlas); 100% coverage of both proteins",source="EBI Proteins API proteomics"),
 dict(analysis="tissue expression",result="both >28 TPM in all 54 GTEx tissues; log2 ratio range -2.78 to +0.97",source="GTEx v8 API"),
])
tab.to_csv("rpl36a_paralog_evidence_table.csv",index=False)
print("\n",tab.to_string(index=False))
